text:
maya: Quick sync — PRD/spec question for fallback routing. I want to confirm launch scope: propose minimal launch that supports tier-based routing (prod/high-priority vs low-priority), region affinity, and a single compatible-variant fallback per model family. Need acceptance criteria, test plan, and sign-offs. cc @sam @liam

sam: +1 to minimal launch, but flag: 'single compatible-variant' can be risky. Tokenizer/IO differences sometimes break outputs. Can we define a compatibility matrix (simple at first) and fall back only when compat_check passes? Also need perf regression gates.

liam: We can ship with a compatibility matrix backend but default to a simple rule: same architecture + same quantization flag => compatible. We should also add a fallback cost budget so we don't accidentally route 10% of traffic to an expensive variant.

anya: From product: launch acceptance criteria proposals: 
- fallback_rate <= 1% after 2 weeks of traffic
- fallback-attributable errors <= 0.1%
- latency p95 for routed requests <= 110% of baseline
These need to be in the PRD.

maya: Good. Also we need region kill-switch and per-tenant override for enterprise customers (they can opt out of fallback). Edge-case: if a customer pins a model version, we must never remap without explicit consent.

sam: Edge cases to call out: sequence length / context window mismatch, tokenizer mismatch, model config flags (stop tokens, eos behavior). Plan: enforce token-capacity and tokenizer hash check prior to routing. If incompatible -> return 422 with a structured reason. Pseudocode: 
```
if request.model.pinned:
  route = pinned
elif within_region and tier_available:
  route = preferred_variant
elif compat_check(preferred_variant, fallback_variant):
  route = fallback_variant
else:
  return 422, {"error":"incompatible_fallback","reason":"tokenizer_mismatch"}
```

liam: Test matrix (initial):
- unit tests for compat_check across common model families
- e2e synthetic load to validate routing under preferred-pool drain
- chaos test: simulate region outage and verify fallback + metrics
- smoke test: verify KV/cache warming behavior after fallback route
I'll add these as tickets.

maya: Metrics we must track: fallback_rate, fallback_latency_delta (per-model), fallback_cost_ratio, fallback_error_reasons (tagged). Need dashboard card in Redwood Console and alerts on fallback_rate > 2% for more than 30m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: RFC draft created: https://rfc.redwood/357 — reviewers: @sam @anya

anya: Reviewers to include infra, runtime, security (KMS/key assumptions). Also include an acceptance test plan and a short customer-facing FAQ describing: when we might remap, how to opt-out, and billing implications.

sam: Quick ETA from eng: minimal scoped work + tests ~3 sprints. If we include a compatibility-matrix UI and per-tenant overrides up-front add ~2 more sprints. We should prioritize minimal launch for customer unblock.

maya: Decision proposed: ship minimal (tier + region + single-variant fallback using simple compat rule) with acceptance criteria from @anya. Next actions: @sam attach a 1-page spec snippet by EOD, @liam scope tests and create tickets, I'll schedule a review with security & infra next week.

liam: ACK — will create tickets and add to eng-sprints board.

maya: :thumbsup: Thanks all — I'll update PRD and tag the reviewers once spec snippet is in.
